title: Methane plume segmentation from Sentinel-2 at known super-emitter sites (CH4Net)

s2.notes: The paper uses 13 bands; the released code defaults to 12 channels. Which band is missing, and the scaling applied by Sentinel Hub, are not documented. The multi-band multi-pass (MBMP) images used for labelling are shipped but are not model inputs.

target.label_source: hand-drawn by one annotator on MBMP difference images against a clear reference image per site

official.definition: Train: 2017–2020 images; validation: 256 training images sampled at random, stratified by plume presence; test: all 2021 images (Vaughan et al. 2024). The Hugging Face release has 8,255 / 255 / 2,473 files, which does not match the paper's 10,046 images.

extra_tests.name: new-site
extra_tests.definition: All 23 sites appear in both train and test, and the release has no site, date or coordinate metadata, so a held-out-site test cannot be built from it.

primary_metric.name: IoU (Plume)
primary_metric.averaging: plume-class pixels pooled over the test set

secondary_metrics.name: scene balanced accuracy
secondary_metrics.averaging: over test scenes; a scene is positive if it has a connected region over 115 px with probability ≥ 0.25 (paper rule)

evaluation.inference: whole image scored on the native grid (the paper scores a centred 100 × 100 crop)

harness: Not in any audited benchmark suite; subdomain 6.1 (greenhouse-gas point sources) has no benchmark task.
The paper trains on random 100 × 100 crops, balancing positives and negatives each epoch.
open_questions: Licence is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: EOArena can evaluate on it but probably cannot redistribute converted data, which is a derivative. Users would download it themselves.
Test images with no plume make pixel IoU dominated by plume scenes; is scene-level balanced accuracy the better primary metric?
Resolve the released-count mismatch and the 12 vs 13 band question with the authors before publishing results.
